best_idea: Queue hedgehog voice lines in a fixed 8-slot queue that plays one line at a time, never repeats the last line, and lets a victory interrupt fade and clear it, while a stinger pauses the music only after the sting has started.
decision_why: Take the voice queue, the stinger hold-and-resume and the focus dampen; the donor's stinger pauses before knowing the sting played, a fallback entry can block the queue (latent), and the dampen can save an already-dampened level; all three are fixed in the sketch.
acceptance: In a fight a hedgehog's lines play one at a time, the same line is never queued twice in a row for one hog, and a victory interrupt fades the lines out within 800 ms; a client test asserts that a failed sting leaves the music playing and that a second dampen does not change the level restored on focus return.
